parameters.query:
-- Only the client's own booking (0038).
select * from client_appointment($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid);

-- Checks for clashes (no two confirmed viewings at once) before touching the calendar.
select client_reschedule_appointment($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz) as result;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ start: { dateTime: $('Check Booking').first().json.new_starts_at, timeZone: $('Check Booking').first().json.info.timezone }, end: { dateTime: $('Check Booking').first().json.new_ends_at, timeZone: $('Check Booking').first().json.info.timezone } }) }}
